title: Crown Overview Tools
description: Scene-gated strategic overview map tools for Crown of Ashes. v1.1.66 starts from the stable v1.1.65 performance build and adds situational Diplomacy trait/quirk rules (Patriot, Synchronist, Cultural Supremicist, Unorthodox, Valyraboo, Blasphemer, Kinslayer, Bastard) plus -1 Diplomacy for Dishonorable.
